final-summary.line_2: W praktyce Knull ma czystszą ścieżkę wyniszczenia i domykania walki, gdy kontakt i regeneracja zaczynają się powtarzać.
final-summary.line_3: Prawdziwa droga Odina istnieje tylko wtedy, gdy ta pełna konfiguracja daje mu właściwą kontrę na Otchłań.

final-summary.winner: Lekka przewaga Knulla, ale pojedynek pozostaje warunkowy.

interpretation.headline: INTERPRETACJA
interpretation.line_1: Kyle ma szerszy profil, lepszy rytm walki i pełniejszy aktywny arsenał.
interpretation.line_2: Manhattan nadal prowadzi w domyślnej wersji walki, bo może zaatakować samo przygotowanie, zanim najlepsza ścieżka Kyle'a w ogóle powstanie.
interpretation.line_3: Przewaga na papierze nie przetrwa, jeśli walka nigdy nie osiągnie symetrycznych warunków wymiany.
interpretation.quote: Kyle wygrywa kategorie. Manhattan wygrywa ten moment, w którym walka staje się realna.
interpretation.subtitle: Kto wygrywa walkę na papierze?

verdict-matrix.case_1: Dr. Manhattan 6.5/10. Pełne przepisywanie utrzymuje Kyle'a w grze, ale proaktywna preempcja nadal kradnie dość otwarć, by zostać minimalnie z przodu.

verdict-matrix.case_3: Kyle 7/10. Jeśli Manhattan robi się pasywny, a Kyle dochodzi do pełnej ekspresji, szerszy arsenał wreszcie się spienięża.
verdict-matrix.case_4: Dr. Manhattan 6.5/10. Pasywność zmniejsza przewagę, ale ograniczony dostęp do Life Equation nadal zostawia Kyle'a z przygotowaniem, które Manhattan potrafi rozplątać.

verdict-matrix.subtitle: Wygrana zależy od zasad walki.

dossierA.text: Technical pressure fighting with the Force. He combines perfect lightsaber swordsmanship with brutal telekinesis to choke and crush opponents in close quarters.
dossierA.title: Style

dossierA.text: Elite precision and an iron defense. His mastery of the Force allows him to control the environment and the enemy's body, preventing effective counterattacks.
dossierA.title: Advantage

dossierA.text: Cold, patient, and ruthless. He waits for the smallest mistake from the opponent to end the fight with a single, vengeful strike.
dossierA.title: Mentality

dossierB.text: Brutal, precise powerhouse combat. Thanos combines mastery of hand-to-hand combat with devastating cosmic energy blasts to systematically crush any defense.
dossierB.title: Style

dossierB.text: Near-absolute invulnerability and tactical genius. He possesses a body capable of surviving attacks from gods and a mind that instantly turns an enemy's mistake into their inevitable defeat.
dossierB.title: Advantage

dossierB.text: Arrogant nihilist with iron discipline. He fights with absolute certainty of his superiority, seeking to ruthlessly crush anyone who stands in his way.
dossierB.title: Mentality

profileA.title: Powers

profileA.title: Weaknesses

profileB.text: Arrogance and tendency to test opponents can create early openings.

profileB.title: Weaknesses

battle-dynamics.analysis: Vader can control moments. Thanos controls what the fight becomes.
battle-dynamics.headline: BATTLE DYNAMICS
battle-dynamics.phase_1: Vader starts higher because his control and timing make the first exchange dangerous.
battle-dynamics.phase_2: Thanos grows stronger as soon as the first bypass fails and the fight turns physical.
battle-dynamics.phase_3: Vader's line collapses once he has to absorb cosmic-level punishment repeatedly.
battle-dynamics.subtitle: How the fight changes minute by minute.

character-dossier-a.advantage: Cybernetic endurance and the power of the Force. Armor allows him to ignore most attacks, while telekinesis serves to paralyze and crush enemies.
character-dossier-a.mentality: Cold, vengeful inevitability. Knows neither mercy nor fear – presses on relentlessly until he completely breaks the opponent's resistance and will.
character-dossier-a.quote: All I am surrounded by is fear. And dead men.
character-dossier-a.style: Brutal swordsmanship with Djem So form. Vader uses cybernetic strength to overwhelm the opponent and break any defense with pure physical pressure.

character-dossier-b.advantage: Near-absolute invulnerability and tactical genius. Possesses a body capable of surviving god-tier attacks and a mind that instantly turns an enemy's mistake into their inevitable defeat.
character-dossier-b.mentality: Arrogant nihilist with iron discipline. Fights with absolute certainty of his superiority, seeking the ruthless suppression of anyone who stands in his way.
character-dossier-b.quote: I did not force you to fight me. You forced me into doing what I did. I had to be faithful to my nature. For, after all, I am Thanos.
character-dossier-b.style: Brutal, precise power fighting. Thanos combines mastery of hand-to-hand combat with devastating cosmic energy blasts to systematically crush any defense.

final-summary.headline: FINAL SUMMARY
final-summary.line_1: Vader wins precision categories, but Thanos wins the categories that actually decide the finish.
final-summary.line_2: Vader's opening remains dangerous, yet the durability and scale gap are too large to solve consistently.
final-summary.line_3: This is a stable matchup, not a branch-heavy one.

character-dossier-a.style: Brutal, primal aggression. Atrocitus charges at opponents to physically tear them apart with bare hands, supported by searing rage plasma that burns through matter and space itself.

character-dossier-b.advantage: Unlimited strength growth and regeneration. The more injured and angry he becomes, the stronger he gets, making him practically unbeatable in a fight of attrition.
character-dossier-b.mentality: Stubborn and wild destroyer. Does not calculate or retreat – presses on until every resistance is leveled with the ground.
character-dossier-b.style: Unstoppable close-quarters destruction. Relies on pure physical strength and constant forward momentum, crushing everything under his strikes.

fight-simulation.headline: FIGHT SIMULATION
fight-simulation.phase_1_body: Atrocitus opens with flight, plasma, and blood-rage control to keep Hulk from building a simple rhythm.
fight-simulation.phase_2_body: Hulk absorbs the first control layer and keeps trying to collapse distance until the fight becomes physical anyway.
fight-simulation.phase_3_body: If Atrocitus keeps the fight external, he can stay ahead. If Hulk gets a second real contact sequence, regeneration and gamma escalation start erasing the value of every partial success.
fight-simulation.subtitle: The course of the fight across three phases.

final-summary.headline: FINAL SUMMARY
final-summary.line_1: Atrocitus wins the paper comparison, 85.6 vs 83.9.
final-summary.line_2: Hulk wins more real fights because repeat contact and regeneration create the cleaner finish route.
final-summary.line_3: Atrocitus only flips the matchup if distance and control hold from start to finish.
final-summary.subtitle: Summary

interpretation.answer: Atrocitus wins the paper comparison, but Hulk still wins more real fights.
interpretation.body: Atrocitus owns the cleaner early toolkit, better speed, and stronger control options. Hulk owns the cleaner finish route once contact becomes repeatable. This is a matchup where the paper edge belongs to the more versatile side, but the practical edge belongs to the side whose loop gets stronger every time the control plan slips.

interpretation.question: Who wins the fight on paper?
interpretation.subtitle: Who wins the fight on paper?

stat-trap.body: Better averages do not matter if they do not create a finish route. Atrocitus has more ways to shape the opening, but Hulk gets more dangerous every time the fight resets into contact. This is not about who has more tools. It is about whose win condition stays intact after the first plan fails.

final-summary.headline: PODSUMOWANIE KOŃCOWE
final-summary.line_1: Atrocitus wygrywa porównanie na papierze, 85.6 vs 83.9.
final-summary.line_2: Hulk wygrywa więcej realnych walk, bo powtarzalny kontakt i regeneracja tworzą czystszą ścieżkę kończenia.
final-summary.line_3: Atrocitus odwraca ten pojedynek tylko wtedy, gdy dystans i kontrola utrzymują się od początku do końca.
final-summary.subtitle: Podsumowanie

interpretation.answer: Atrocitus wygrywa porównanie na papierze, ale Hulk wygrywa więcej realnych walk.
interpretation.body: Atrocitus ma czystszy wczesny arsenał, lepszą szybkość i mocniejsze narzędzia kontroli. Hulk ma czystszą ścieżkę kończenia, gdy kontakt staje się powtarzalny. To pojedynek, w którym przewaga na papierze należy do bardziej wszechstronnej strony, ale przewaga praktyczna należy do tej, której pętla robi się groźniejsza po każdym załamaniu planu kontroli.
interpretation.headline: INTERPRETACJA
interpretation.question: Kto wygrywa walkę na papierze?
interpretation.subtitle: Kto wygrywa walkę na papierze?

stat-trap.body: Lepsze średnie nic nie znaczą, jeśli nie tworzą prawdziwej ścieżki kończenia. Atrocitus ma więcej sposobów, by ułożyć początek walki, ale Hulk staje się groźniejszy za każdym razem, gdy walka wraca do kontaktu. To nie jest pytanie o to, kto ma więcej narzędzi. To pytanie o to, czyj warunek zwycięstwa zostaje nienaruszony po porażce pierwszego planu.

stat-trap.question: Czy Atrocitus utrzyma gniew Hulka na zewnątrz, czy sam zacznie karmić tę pętlę?
stat-trap.subtitle: Dlaczego lepsze statystyki nie gwarantują zwycięstwa
